title: Ekitongole Ekikwasiddwa Omugga
intro: Omwoyo gwayolekagana n’ekiragiro ekitasoboka, ng’obulamu bw’omwana omuwere bwawanikiddwa mu minzaani. Nga baluŋŋamizibwa okuluŋŋamizibwa okw’obwakatonda, ekiragiro eky’okuggwaamu essuubi kyagonderwa, era ekyama eky’omuwendo ne kiteekebwa ku mugga, kyokka ne kiddizibwa mu ngeri etaali ya bulijjo.
clues: Nabeera wansi w’ekisiikirize ky’omutyobooli eyalagira okutta abasajja abaakazaalibwa.
Okubudaabudibwa okw’obwakatonda kwajja gye ndi, nga kundagirira okukola ekikolwa eky’okuggwaamu essuubi era ekimenya omutima.
Nateeka omwana wange omuwere ow’omuwendo mu kifuba ne mmuteeka ku mugga ogwali gukulukuta.
Omutima gwange gwafuuka bwereere, era katono nfune ekyama, naye Allah n’anyweza obumalirivu bwange.
Nasindika omuntu okugoberera olugendo lw’omwana wansi ng’omugga gutwala ekifuba.
Omwana yasangiddwa amaka g’omutyobooli, era okukkakkana nga, nnaddamu okukwatagana n’omwana wange ne nfuuka nnansi.

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
